This dataset contains seventeen (17) point clouds of the Moose Hill Ranch Residence. The data was collected by the Capture2Preserv team on August 4th, 2022. The Z+F 5010X scanner captured the exterior with sixteen (16) scans which were registered in Z+F Laser Control Scout. The Leica BLK 360 was used to capture as much of the interior as safely as possible and captured a total of eleven (11) scans. Due to the incomplete nature of the interior the registration was an issue and has therefore been combined into a single point cloud. The interior scans were registered on-site with Cyclone Field 360 and then combined with the Z+F 5010X data in AutoDesk ReCap Pro.
